cohort: 174 women with uterine fibroids who underwent ultrasound-guided HIFU therapy and planned future pregnancies
finding: Ultrasound-guided HIFU ablation appears to be a promising treatment for women with uterine fibroids desiring future pregnancies, with vaginal delivery after the procedure being both feasible and safe.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery after ultrasound-guided HIFU ablation treatment appears to be feasible and safe, with 21 out of 26 scheduled vaginal deliveries being successful and no complications reported during pregnancy or labor.
